title: Time-Travel Incrimination: How Far Back Should You Resample?

original_idea.body: Implement time-travel resampling on a small multi-step benchmark, sweep the look-back window, and measure attack-catch rate and benign-usefulness cost vs window size to find the knee.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: An operating-point recommendation (look-back window) for a strong control protocol is actionable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Implement time-travel resampling, sweep window; building the protocol loop is a moderate inherited task.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused catch-rate/cost-vs-window curve; protocol implementation is a dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open models, reproducible, third-party protocol characterization.

low_compute.reasoning: Multi-step resampling on open models, modest cost.

novelty.reasoning: Time-travel variant described; look-back window characterization may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Time-travel variant exists; window-size characterization may be open.
